bottleneck.description: Top global producer of high-purity TMAH photoresist developer for EUV/advanced-node lithography plus semiconductor-grade polysilicon (~12,500 MT capacity, 7nm-and-below grade).

dependency.key_customers: TSMC, Samsung, leading-edge foundries via wafer/resist channels; Japanese and Korean fabs primarily
dependency.key_suppliers: Trichlorosilane/silicon metal captive production, specialty chemicals

editorial.notes: Tokuyama is a major TMAH developer supplier (top-5 controls ~56% share) and a credible semiconductor-grade polysilicon producer alongside Wacker and Hemlock. Asia-Pacific dependence on Tokuyama for TMAH at advanced nodes is real. However, alternatives exist (Greenda, Hantok, Tama, SACHEM in TMAH; Wacker, Hemlock in poly), making MEDIUM the disciplined call. Switching is multi-quarter qualification but feasible.
